MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 11
   C. 8
   D. 7

2. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

3. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 24

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 15

11. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

12. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
